caption: The drawing features four rectangular swatches of woven fabric, arranged vertically in a single column on a plain, light-colored background. The top swatch consists of a checked pattern with brown, green, and blue threads. The second swatch features blue and pink diagonal stripes with white accents. The third swatch is primarily a mix of tan, blue, and light orange threads, creating a small check or basket-weave pattern. The bottom swatch displays a horizontally striped pattern in brown, blue, white, and black. All four swatches are of similar size and are evenly spaced from each other on the page.
title: Tapes for Chair Seat
